repos_data.description: 🏆 Self-hosted, open-source WebRTC video conferencing platform for real-time communication and collaboration. A modern alternative to Zoom, Google Meet, Jitsi Meet, and Microsoft Teams, powered by scalable SFU architecture with Mediasoup.
Low-latency remote desktop for macOS and Linux. Control your computer from an iPad or any browser with ~20 ms delay. Free, open source, no app to install. curl -fsSL glassdesk.dev | sh
